status: Published Windows singleplayer alpha v0.1.0-alpha.1 (2026-11-18) remains the verified install package and predates the T-112 pathfinding work. The source engine now reaches 30.06 ms / 33.3 FPS in the 481-frame Last Stand heavy window with the opt-in 66% ally-congestion price (path 9,684 vs 14,680 us/frame; deterministic CRC 695F3403 but gameplay-changing) and 29.01 ms / 34.5 FPS with three visual trades. The 33% price is the user's feel choice and the source playtest default; it resolves the replay at about frame 8,400. Native D3D8 stays on the Intel iGPU; the optional d3d8to9 wrapper routes the same build to the GTX 1650 Ti (46.87 -> 36.80 ms, exact reference CRC). Behaviour-preserving levers (cache TTL, prefetch, workers, admissible heuristic, render thread, draw batching) are measured and rejected; the remaining serial path work is ordinary/closest/attack searches. Open: T-116 group path failures, T-117 deploy guard, T-128 live stuck groups, packaging the opt-in profile, and replay validation. The public source snapshot is T-129.

The remaining optimization work is integration and validation, not another local lever: T-116 group path failures, T-117 deploy guard, and T-128 live stuck groups. T-129 published the source/docs snapshot and refreshed the public README.
